ToxicDart.name: Toxic Dart
ToxicDart.description: Projectile that deals damage and applies poison over time. Shoots closest unpoisoned enemy.

ShadowStrike.name: Shadow Strike
ShadowStrike.description: Dash away from closest enemy and shoot a slowing projectile.

Cleave.name: Cleave
Cleave.description: Cleaves nearby enemies and applies bleed.

Stomp.name: Stomp
Stomp.description: Stomps the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back.

SteelPlume.name: Steel Plume
SteelPlume.description: Shoot piercing projectile to closest enemy. Slows on hit.

EmberSpit.name: Ember Spit
EmberSpit.description: Shoot a fiery projectile at nearest enemy. Explodes on impact, burning enemies in the area.

VenomFang.name: Venom Fang
VenomFang.description: Strike 3 close enemies. Apply poison and bleed.

IronWing.name: Iron Wing
IronWing.description: Strike enemies in a cone. Gain shield for each enemy hit.

DragonBreath.name: Dragon Breath
DragonBreath.description: Hit enemies in a wide cone. Deal increased damage if target is poisoned.

Tremor.name: Tremor
Tremor.description: Hit enemies in line toward closest enemy. Damage, slow, and apply bleed.

PhoenixDive.name: Phoenix Dive
PhoenixDive.description: Jump to the furthest enemy location, damage and knock back enemies.

Pounce.name: Pounce
Pounce.description: Dash to closest enemy, deal high damage and get 20% damage done as shield.

CrimsonSpike.name: Crimson Spike
CrimsonSpike.description: Shoot projectile towards the enemy with lowest health. Applies bleed.

SerpentDance.name: Serpent Dance
SerpentDance.description: Quickly strikes enemies in medium range 10 times. Inflict poison. Apply shield for each unique enemy hit.

DragonTail.name: Dragon Tail
DragonTail.description: Strikes in a straight line towards closest enemy in long range. Grants a shield.

ToxicPool.name: Toxic Pool
ToxicPool.description: Spawns pool under the closest enemy that deals periodic damage, slows and applies poison.
